title: Project and Pack methods
summary: yoke qa mission host-command --timeout-seconds defaults to 60 and allows at most 900. A --gui-session command that times out has its whole process tree stopped and reports gui_command_timeout_stopped; when it cannot be confirmed gone it reports gui_command_timeout_not_stopped, keeps its output files and names their paths. A Terminal window left open is named gui_command_window_not_closed beside the command's own answer. A Yoke setup, connect or onboard call with a timeout under the 600s browser-approval wait prints the warning host_command_timeout_below_approval_wait.
